say_intro: 마리아나 해구 바닥에 떨어지면, 몇 분이나 버틸 수 있을까요?

beats.say: 여기는 수심 10,935미터, 바다에서 가장 깊은 곳이에요.
beats.img: the pitch-black floor of the deepest ocean trench, fine grey silt seafloor stretching into darkness, drifting marine snow caught in one faint beam of light

beats.say: 햇빛은 1,000미터 아래로 못 내려와요. 여긴 완전한 어둠이에요.
beats.img: looking straight down into the endless dark abyss of the open ocean, sunlight fading from deep blue to total black, tiny drifting particles
ice-cold deep sea water over a grey silt seafloor, cold blue tint, a small round metal probe resting on the sediment, faint light
a heavy titanium deep-sea instrument sphere resting on the dark seafloor, rim-lit by a dim blue glow, immense crushing darkness above
an empty plain plastic bottle crushed flat by water pressure lying on the deep seafloor, dim blue light, drifting particles
a small white balloon shrunk into a tiny wrinkled ball deep underwater, dark blue water, a single dramatic beam of light from above

caption: 마리아나 해구 바닥, 몇 분 버틸까? 🌊

bench.format: 심해 과학 호기심 릴스 — 질문 훅 → 큰 숫자 박자 → 판정(인스타 검색 '심해' 상위 620만·370만·225만·210만·190만, 10/14)
